basic_details.job_title: CIPET:IPT Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering & Technology (CIPET:IPT), Raipur, under the Department of Chemicals & Petrochemicals, Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Govt. of India, has invited applications for 1 Project Associate - I post in the CARS sponsored project "Formulation of Rubber Compounds for Self-Sealing Flexible Fuel Tank Materials" from DMSRDE, Kanpur. The pay is Rs. 31000/- or Rs 25000/- per month plus applicable HRA, as per qualification and eligibility. Applications must reach CIPET, Raipur by registered post on or before 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites "eligible and interested personnel" for the Project Associate - I position. The educational qualification, experience and other eligibility criteria are not printed in the notice. It says these details, along with the period of engagement, terms and conditions and the application format, are on the website www.cipet.gov.in . The two pay figures depend on "qualification & eligibility", so the pay offered to a candidate is linked to those criteria.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid as applicable, in addition to the pay. The notice does not state which qualification receives which of the two amounts.

Make sure the application reaches CIPET, Raipur on or before 17 November 2026. For further clarification, the notice gives the contact number +91 9424384803. The institute's letterhead also prints the phone number 07771-6673001-30 and the e-mail [email protected] .
